ir.name: diff_weight_all_pairs
ir.intuition: All pairwise comparisons weighted by sum of absolute differences in objective and log_prob to ensure non-uniform instance weights.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    weight = (objective[b_idx, winner_idx] - objective[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs() + (log_prob[b_idx, winner_idx] - log_prob[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs()
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'diff_weight_all_pairs'})

ir.name: loss_diff_squared_costgap
ir.intuition: Use a regression paradigm on cost gap differences, penalizing squared error between predicted preference margin (log_prob difference) and cost gap signal, encouraging calibrated margin predictions.
ir.pseudocode:
predicted_margin = lpw - lpl
error = predicted_margin - cost_gap
loss = mean(weight * error^2)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    pred_margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    error = ops.sub(pred_margin, cost_gap)
    squared_error = ops.mul(error, error)
    weighted_error = ops.mul(squared_error, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_error)
